name: Project Pals
summary: A Herdr layout that turns your coding agents into a crew of pals: channels as tabs, rooms, tasks, routines, memory
notes: Needs Herdr opened once first. Also installs crewd (a user service) and Claude Code hooks; ~/.claude/settings.json is backed up first.
afterInstall: Switch Herdr to the pals layout with Ctrl+Shift+L.
removeNotes: Its mods are ~/.config/herdr-app/mods/crew-* and its layout is ~/.config/herdr-app/layouts/pals.json; earlier copies are in ~/.config/herdr-app/.crew-backups/.
